rows.label: qst630501_msg0001
rows.name: You lot...

rows.label: qst630501_msg0002
rows.name: You look strong.

rows.label: qst630501_msg0003
rows.name: That's right! We are strong!

rows.label: qst630501_msg0004
rows.name: Do I look strong too?

rows.label: qst630501_msg0005
rows.name:
Um... You, young lady... look more
cute than strong.

rows.label: qst630501_msg0006
rows.name: Hehe... Thank you!

rows.label: qst630501_msg0007
rows.name:
So, it looks like you need something
from us strong-looking types?

rows.label: qst630501_msg0008
rows.name:
Right... Lately, even the Liberalitas
Archipelago has not been peaceful.

rows.label: qst630501_msg0009
rows.name:
A vicious monster called Sea Weiss has
settled on Merukuribe Islet.

rows.label: qst630501_msg0010
rows.name:
So Divine Beast ships cannot travel
safely either.

rows.label: qst630501_msg0011
rows.name:
It has sunk three of them this
month...

rows.label: qst630501_msg0012
rows.name: Right, so...

rows.label: qst630501_msg0013
rows.name:
You look strong, so I want to ask you
to defeat it.

rows.label: qst630501_msg0014
rows.name: Does Raiko look strong too?

rows.label: qst630501_msg0015
rows.name:
Um... The young lady... looks more
cute than strong.

rows.label: qst630501_msg0016
rows.name: Hehe... Thank you!

rows.label: qst630501_msg0017
rows.name:
Back to the matter at hand... I asked
several Drivers before, but all of
them were beaten.

rows.label: qst630501_msg0018
rows.name:
It is in a different league from
ordinary monsters, but the reward will
be generous.

rows.label: qst630501_msg0019
rows.name: Will you take the job?

rows.label: qst630501_msg0020
rows.name:
Nice, I'm fired up! Let's do it,
Driver!

rows.label: qst630501_msg0021
rows.name: That's what I'm talking about!

rows.label: qst630501_msg0022
rows.name: I'll follow my Driver.

rows.label: qst630501_msg0023
rows.name:
I'm a little scared, but I'll do my
very best!

rows.label: qst630501_msg0024
rows.name: Thanks!

rows.label: qst630501_msg0025
rows.name:
Like I said, Sea Weiss is on
Merukuribe Islet.

rows.label: qst630501_msg0026
rows.name: Be very careful!

rows.label: qst630501_msg0101
rows.name: Hmm... Not yet...

rows.label: qst630501_msg0102
rows.name:
You'll need to get stronger, or it
will beat you too...

rows.label: qst630501_msg0201
rows.name:
Leave it to us! We'll
get this sorted out.
